sloka: अर्थानर्थान्तरे बुद्धिर्निश्चिता ऽपि न शोभते ।घातयन्ति हि कार्याणि दूताः पण्डितमानिनः ।। ५.३०.३८।।।।
transliteration: arthānarthāntare buddhirniścitā 'pi na śobhate ।ghātayanti hi kāryāṇi dūtāḥ paṇḍitamāninaḥ ।। 5.30.38।।।।

translations.english: "Swinging from a course of action or an action leading to calamity is not proper. Messengers who assume that they are scholars (blinded by ego) destroy their mission.
